🚨 Boletim de Cyber Segurança - Técnica

Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-59346 - VMware
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: VMware
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.3
Resumo:
VMware Workstation and Fusion contain an integer-overflow vulnerability. A malicious actor with local administrative privileges on a virtual machine with VMXNET3 virtual network adapter may exploit this issue to execute code on the host. Affected versions: - VMware Workstation: 25H2, 26H1 (fixed in 26H1u1) - VMware Fusion: 25H2, 26H1 (fixed in 26H1u1)
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-59346
 
🚨 CVE-2026-102404 - Elastic
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Elastic
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.5
Resumo:
Uncontrolled Resource Consumption (CWE-400) in Elasticsearch can lead to denial of service via Excessive Allocation (CAPEC-130). A low-privileged authenticated user can submit a specially crafted query that causes uncontrolled memory growth in the query processing engine, resulting in an out-of-memory condition that terminates the Elasticsearch node. The condition can be triggered repeatedly, including by queries emb...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102404

🚨 CVE-2026-105636 - Check Point
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Check Point
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.9
Resumo:
Plane is an open-source project management tool. Prior to 1.4.0, the webhook delivery task in apps/api/plane/bgtasks/webhook_task.py calls requests.post() without allow_redirects=False and does not validate redirect targets. validate_url() blocks private, loopback, link-local, and reserved addresses in the original webhook URL, but the final URL reached after one or more redirects is not checked. A user who can creat...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105636

Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 9.3
Resumo:
Threat actors have begun to exploit a newly disclosed critical security flaw impacting Atlassian Data Center products that could allow access to sensitive files under certain conditions. The arbitrary file access flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-21589 (CVSS score: 9.3) affects multiple products, including Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software
Link: https://thehackernews.com/2026/10/atlassian-data-center-flaw-draws.html

Fonte: BleepingComputer

It’s also worth pressure testing, and three questions do the heavy lifting.

"The campaign exploits reused or leaked credentials and legacy SHA-256 password storage, enabling threat

📰 Ransomware has a new target. Is your backup ready?
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: SentinelOne
Fonte: BleepingComputer
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Ransomware groups are increasingly targeting backup infrastructure to eliminate recovery options and increase pressure on victims to pay. Kaseya explains why organizations need isolated, immutable, and regularly tested backups that attackers cannot easily reach.
Link: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/ransomware-has-a-new-target-is-your-backup-ready/

🚨 CVE-2026-83540 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
When password or public key authentication is used with the Windows port of wolfSSHd, the Windows logon token acquired for one authenticated connection is not released before a token is acquired for a subsequent connection, resulting in user login poisoning between connections. A less privileged user with a valid account on the server can exploit this to force a login as a more privileged user. The vulnerability was...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-83540
 
🚨 CVE-2026-105397 - WordPress
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: WordPress
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 5.4
Resumo:
LearnPress plugin for WordPress through 4.4.9.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated instructors to inject scripts via quiz question hint and explanation fields. Attackers with the Instructor role can submit unsanitized payloads through the update_question AJAX handler that execute in the session of every student taking the quiz.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105397
 
🚨 CVE-2026-9226 - Azure
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Azure
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: N/D
Resumo:
Authentication bypass in the Azure AD external login flow in Devolutions Server 2026.3.7.0 and earlier allows a remote attacker to take over a user's account via replay of a captured login-session token exposed in a redirect URL.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-9226
